description: PROCESS-ENTER-KEY's first EVALUATE arm at app/cbl/COUSR03C.cbl:145-150 - re-entry with ENTER pressed and USRIDINI transmitted as SPACES, which is the SPACES half of the compound '= SPACES OR LOW-VALUES' condition at :145. The path is reached through the ELSE at :106 because CDEMO-PGM-CONTEXT is 1 and CDEMO-PGM-REENTER is therefore already true at :95, so :96-105 is skipped and RECEIVE-USRDEL-SCREEN runs at :107. RECEIVE-USRDEL-SCREEN at :232-238 captures RESP and RESP2 and then NEVER EVALUATES THEM; that is reproduced as written and no receive-failure branch is invented. The EVALUATE EIBAID at :108-130 is ordered and its FIRST arm matches - DFHENTER before DFHPF3, DFHPF4, DFHPF5, DFHPF12 and WHEN OTHER - so PROCESS-ENTER-KEY is performed at :110. Inside it :146 raises WS-ERR-FLG to 'Y', :147-148 moves 'User ID can NOT be empty...' into WS-MESSAGE PIC X(80), :149 moves -1 into USRIDINL and :150 performs SEND-USRDEL-SCREEN exactly once. THE DECISIVE GUARD IS :156: with the error flag now raised, 'IF NOT ERR-FLG-ON' is false, so the clear at :157-159 never runs and READ-USER-SEC-FILE is never performed; :164 is false for the same reason so there is no second send. THERE IS NO DATASET ACCESS WHATSOEVER ON THIS PATH - no read, no read-for-update and no delete - which is why expectedWrites is empty and all ten seeded rows are pinned unchanged at indices 0-9: 'nothing happened to USRSEC' is asserted positively rather than left implicit. Gate G47 consequently has NO CALL SITE here, so no FileStatus outcome and no forcedOutcome is declared; inventing one would assert an I/O path this arm does not take. The absence of that guard between the read and the delete inside DELETE-USER-INFO at :188-192 is what makes the PF5 paths behave differently, and pinning the no-I/O outcome here is what gives those cases their contrast. The single send carries all eleven xxxO items: POPULATE-HEADER-INFO at :243-262 paints TRNNAMEO, TITLE01O, PGMNAMEO, TITLE02O, CURDATEO and CURTIMEO, then :217 moves WS-MESSAGE into ERRMSGO PIC X(78), an 80-to-78 right truncation, which is why the two emitted lines are pinned on separate channels at their own declared widths rather than compared across widths. USRIDINO, FNAMEO, LNAMEO and USRTYPEO are transmitted blank because the request carried them blank and :157-159 never ran to alter them. ERRMSGC is NOT written on this arm - DFHNEUTR is moved only at :285 when the lookup succeeds and DFHGREEN only at :317 when the delete succeeds - so the colour asserted is DFHDFCOL, the default that survives where nothing was moved, and the field keeps the BMS-declared ERRMSG ATTRB=(ASKIP,BRT,FSET) COLOR=RED of app/bms/COUSR03.bms:140-143. The offending field is marked the only way this program marks one: COUSR03C copies neither CSSETATY nor CSSTRPFY - its eight COPY statements are COCOM01Y, COUSR03, COTTL01Y, CSDAT01Y, CSMSG01Y, CSUSR01Y, DFHAID and DFHBMSCA - so it sets attributes and tests EIBAID inline, and the MOVE -1 TO USRIDINL at :149 is the cursor and therefore the highlight, pinned as cursorField. Attribute and AID mnemonics come from common.BmsAttributes and common.CicsAid because DFHBMSCA and DFHAID are IBM-supplied and absent from this repository, which is risk R-D. The transaction ends at :134-137 with EXEC CICS RETURN TRANSID('CU03') COMMAREA(CARDDEMO-COMMAREA), so the termination is RETURN_TRANSID rather than XCTL, and every field of the commarea travels back in the payload - no server-side session state exists, which is rule R6 and gate G37 asserted directly rather than assumed. PROVENANCE: every expected value here is STATICALLY DERIVED by structured reading of the sources named below and is NOT captured from, recorded against or replayed from any execution of the legacy COBOL. Running it is empirically impossible in this environment - no z/OS or CICS runtime, the available compiler reports its indexed-file handler as disabled, no Language Environment CEE* services exist, and DFHAID, DFHBMSCA and DFHATTR are absent from the repository - which is the documented eight-blocker deviation escalated as risk R-A; it changes the provenance of the expected values and nothing else. Derived from app/cbl/COUSR03C.cbl:142-162 and :213-225, cross-checked against app/cpy/CSUSR01Y.cpy:18-23 (8+20+20+8+1 = 57 plus SEC-USR-FILLER's 23 = 80), app/cpy/COCOM01Y.cpy:19-44 with app/cbl/COUSR03C.cbl:50-58 (160 + 34 = 194 bytes), app/cpy-bms/COUSR03.CPY where COUSR3AO REDEFINES COUSR3AI so the eleven xxxO items overlay the eleven xxxI items and no password item exists on either side, app/cpy/COTTL01Y.cpy for both forty-character titles, app/cpy/CSDAT01Y.cpy for the MM/DD/YY and HH:MM:SS header shapes, app/bms/COUSR03.bms for the declared field attributes, and the ten in-stream rows of app/jcl/DUSRSECJ.jcl:35-44, whose 57-character width against the LRECL=80 RECFM=FB of :48 and the RECORDSIZE(80,80) KEYS(8,0) of :65-66 is exactly what the declared normalisation supplies. The literal PASSWORD in SEC-USR-PWD is legacy sample data carried byte for byte because CSUSR01Y places it inside the eighty bytes; plaintext credentials are an inherited property of the legacy design rather than a choice made here, this screen has no password field and this path never reads or paints the span, and no hashing, encoding or token is introduced. The seed, the pinned 2022-07-19T23:12:35 clock, the six record field names and the 57-to-80 normalisation are reused byte for byte from case01.json.
